title: Aloittavan yrittäjän neuvontapalvelut
description: Aloittavan yrittäjän neuvontapalvelut 1. Hankinnan kohde Hankinnan kohteena on aloittavien yritysten neuvonta- ja valmennuspalvelukokonaisuus, joka muodostuu kahdesta toisiaan täydentävästä osa-alueesta: 1. yrityksen perustamisneuvonnasta yritystoimintaa suunnitteleville henkilöille sekä 2. yrityksen käynnistämisvaiheen tuesta ja valmennuksesta vastaperustetuille yrityksille. Palvelujen tavoitteena on madaltaa yrittäjäksi ryhtymisen kynnystä, parantaa yritysten toimintaedellytyksiä sekä vahvistaa uusien yritysten elinkelpoisuutta ja jatkuvuutta ensimmäisten toimintavuosien aikana. Palvelukokonaisuuden tulee muodostaa yhtenäinen asiakaspolku liikeidean arvioinnista yrityksen alkuvaiheen kehittämiseen. Tilaajan näkemyksen mukaan palvelu on syytä kilpailuttaa ja tuottaa yhtenä kokonaisuutena, jolloin yritystoimintaa suunnittelevan henkilön ja myöhemmin yrityksen asiakkuus on yhdellä toimijalla. Tällöin palveluntuottaja pystyy parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla tukemaan yritystoimintaa suunnittelevia henkilöitä yrityksen perustamisessa ja vahvistamaan yritysten elinkelpoisuutta ja kasvuedellytyksiä toiminnan alkuvaiheessa. Sopimuskauden aikana Jyväskylässä yritysneuvonta- ja kehittämispalveluita toteutetaan ns. Jyväskylän mallin mukaisesti osana Yritystalo-toimintakonseptia. Yritystalo on yksi yhteinen palvelukeskus, jonka toiminta-ajatuksena on tuoda kaikki kaupungin yritys- ja työnantajapalvelut saman katon alle. 2. Sopimuskausi ja hankinnan arvo Sopimuskausi on 1.1.2027-31.12.2028. Hankintaan sisältyy tilaajan yksipuolinen optio ajalle 1.1.2029-31.12.2029. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo optiokausi mukaan lukien on noin 780 000 euroa (alv 0 %). Tilaaja ei sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin. 3. Palvelun kohderyhmät Palvelut suunnataan erityisesti seuraaville asiakasryhmille: • työttömät työnhakijat • maahanmuuttajat • nuoret • opiskelijat • työssäkäyvät henkilöt • muut yritystoiminnan aloittamista suunnittelevat henkilöt Yrityksen perustamisneuvontaa tarjotaan Jyväskylässä asuville henkilöille. Käynnistämisvaiheen tukea tarjotaan Jyväskylään perustetuille tai pääasiallisesti Jyväskylässä toimiville yrityksille enintään 18 kuukauden ajan yrityksen perustamisesta. 4. Palvelun sisältö 4.1 Yrityksen perustamisneuvonta Palveluntuottajan tulee tarjota yritystoiminnan aloittamista suunnitteleville asiakkaille asiantuntevaa, maksutonta ja puolueetonta neuvontaa. Perustamisneuvonnan tulee sisältää vähintään: • henkilökohtainen yritysneuvonta • ryhmämuotoiset info- ja neuvontatilaisuudet • liikeidean arviointi • yrittäjävalmiuksien arviointi • liiketoimintasuunnitelman laadinnan ohjaus • talous- ja kannattavuuslaskelmien ohjaus • markkina- ja kilpailutilanteen arviointi • yritysmuodon valintaan liittyvä neuvonta • rahoitus-, lupa- ja viranomaisprosesseihin liittyvä ohjaus • yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvä käytännön ohjaus. Palveluntuottajan tulee kyetä palvelemaan asiakkaita suomeksi ja englanniksi. Muiden kielten osalta palveluntuottajan tulee kuvata käytettävät ratkaisut. 4.2 Yrityksen käynnistämisvaiheen tuki ja valmennus Palveluntuottajan tulee tarjota vastaperustetuille yrityksille suunnitelmallista tukea ja valmennusta yrityksen ensimmäisten toimintakuukausien aikana. Tuen tulee perustua mahdollisuuksien mukaan yrityksen perustamisvaiheessa laadittuihin suunnitelmiin, laskelmiin ja kehittämistoimenpiteisiin. Palveluntuottajan tulee varmistaa asiakkuuden saumaton jatkuminen perustamisvaiheesta käynnistämisvaiheen palveluihin. Käynnistämisvaiheen palvelun tulee sisältää vähintään: • yritystoiminnan alkuvaiheen tilannekartoitus • liiketoimintasuunnitelman päivittäminen • myynnin ja markkinoinnin kehittäminen • hinnoittelun ja kannattavuuden seuranta • talouden hallinnan ohjaus • kassavirran hallinnan tuki • digitaalisten työkalujen hyödyntämisen ohjaus • verkostojen ja yhteistyökumppaneiden tunnistaminen • kasvun ja kehittämisen mahdollisuuksien arviointi • yksilöllinen yritysvalmennus. Palvelun tulee olla asiakkaan käytettävissä enintään 18 kuukauden ajan yrityksen perustamisesta. 5. Tavoitteet Tilaajan tavoitteena on, että palvelu: • edistää uusien yritysten syntymistä Jyväskylään • lisää yrittäjyyden houkuttelevuutta eri kohderyhmissä • parantaa yritysten alkuvaiheen menestymismahdollisuuksia • vähentää yritystoiminnan alkuvaiheen keskeytymistä • tukee työllistymistä yrittäjyyden kautta • vahvistaa alueen elinvoimaa. Palveluntuottajan tulee toiminnassaan tavoitella vähintään seuraavan suuruisia palveluvolyymejä: • vähintään 250 uutta perustamisneuvonnan asiakasta vuodessa • vähintään 130 perustamisneuvonnan seurauksena syntyvää yritystä vuodessa. Tilaaja käyttää tavoitteita palvelun vaikuttavuuden arvioinnissa. 6. Palvelun toteuttamistapa Palveluntuottajan tulee järjestää palvelut ensisijaisesti Jyväskylässä. Palveluntuottajan tulee sitoutua tuottamaan palvelua osana Jyväskylän kaupungin Jyväskylän mallin mukaista Yritystalo-konseptia. Palvelua tulee olla saatavilla: • lähitapaamisina • etäpalveluina • puhelin- ja verkkoneuvontana • ryhmätilaisuuksina. Palveluntuottajan tulee huolehtia asiakkaiden yhdenvertaisesta kohtelusta ja palvelujen saavutettavuudesta. 7. Tarjoajan soveltuvuus Tarjoajalla tulee olla: • riittävä kokemus aloittavien yritysten neuvonnasta tai yritysten kehittämispalveluiden tuottamisesta • käytettävissään riittävä määrä yritysneuvonnan asiantuntijoita • osaaminen yrityksen perustamisesta, liiketoiminnan suunnittelusta, yritysrahoituksesta, taloudesta ja yritysten kehittämisestä • valmius tuottaa palvelua monikanavaisesti • asiakasohjausmalli yrittäjän osaamisen vahvistamiseksi Jyväskylän seudun koulutustarjontaa hyödyntäen • dokumentoitu laadunhallintamalli ja vähintään kahden vuoden kokemus ao. laadunhallintamallin toteuttamisesta Tarjoajan soveltuvuutta arvioidaan soveltuvuusvaatimusten ja laatukriteerien perusteella.,

title: Kielotie 28:n toimisto- ja liikerakennuksen purku-urakka
description: Kielotie 28:n toimisto- ja liikerakennuksen purku-urakka Kiinteistö Oy Lehdokkitien Virastotalo pyytää tarjoustanne Kielotie 28:n toimisto- ja liikerakennuksen purku-urakasta kiinteähintaisena kokonaisurakkana tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liiteasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Hankinta toteutetaan avoimella menettelyllä. Purku-urakan kohde on vuonna 1983 valmistunut toimisto- ja liikerakennus, jonka bruttopinta-ala on 6 967 m2. Rakennuksessa on kaksi osaa. Osassa A on neljä kerrosta, kellarikerros sekä osittainen ullakkokerros. Rakennus on perustettu paalujen varaan. Alapohja ja maanvastaiset seinät ovat betonirakenteiset. Rakennuksen runko on paikalla valettu ja se koostuu kantavista ulkoseinistä ja pilaripalkkirungosta. A-osan kellarikerroksessa on sosiaalitiloja, teknisiä tiloja, varastoja ja rakennuksen väestönsuojatilat. B-osa on kolmikerroksinen ja kauttaaltaan nostettu betonipilarien varaan. B-osassa on toimistotiloja kerroksissa 2–4. Väliseinät ovat molemmissa rakennusosissa pääosin muurattuja ja toimistotilojen välillä kevytrakenteisia siirtoseiniä. Rakennuksen vesikattona on bitumikermikatto, sisäpuolisella vedenpoistolla. Rakennuksessa ei ole tehty kattavaa peruskorjausta ja se on pinnoiltaan pääosin alkuperäisessä kunnossa. Kielotie 28:n kortteli on Vantaan kaupunkiympäristön toimialan toimintojen pääasiallisessa käytössä aiemmin ollut toimisto- ja liikerakennus, joka on nyttemmin tyhjentynyt ja poistettu käytöstä. Kaupunkikonsernissa on tehty päätökset kohteen purkamisesta. Kohteen omistaa Kiinteistö Oy Lehdokkitien Virastotalo, jonka osakekannan omistavat yhdessä Vantaan kaupunki ja kaupunkikonserniin kuuluva Vivamus Kiinteistöt Oy. Osakkaat ovat sopineet, että Vivamus Kiinteistöt Oy ohjaa ja koordinoi purku-ukakkaa. Vivamus Kiinteistöt Oy on tehnyt mm. purku-urakassa tarvittavat suunnittelu- ja asiantuntijapalvelusopimukset lukuunsa. Kiinteistö Oy Lehdokkitien Virastotalo pyytää tällä tarjouspyynnöllä tarjouksia kohteen purku-urakasta, jonka tarkempi laajuus ilmenee tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevista asiakirjoista. description: Klaipėdos švietimo įstaigų riebalų gaudyklių montavimo darbai su projektavimu (toliau – darbai ir paslaugos). Reikalavimai pirkimo objektui nustatyti specialiųjų pirkimo sąlygų 1-6 prieduose. Darbai ir Paslaugos perkami pagal Techninę specifikaciją (specialiųjų pirkimo sąlygų 2-4 priedai) ir projektavimo užduotis II ir III pirkimo dalims (specialiųjų pirkimo sąlygų 5, 6 priedai). Darbų kiekiai, nurodyti konkurso sąlygų aprašo 1 priede, yra preliminarūs. Sutarties vykdymo metu preliminarūs kiekiai gali būti mažinami arba gali būti didinami. Maksimaliai darbų gali būti užsakoma I pirkimo daliai už ne daugiau kaip 8 000,00 Eur su PVM (arba 6 6 11,57 Eur be PVM Eur be PVM, jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar darbai neapmokestinami PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM), II pirkimo daliai už ne daugiau kaip 54 500,00 Eur su PVM (arba 45 041,32 Eur be PVM, jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar darbai neapmokestinami PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM), III pirkimo daliai už ne daugiau kaip 54 500,00 Eur su PVM (arba 45 041,32 Eur be PVM, jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar darbai neapmokestinami PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM). Pirkimo objektas skaidomas į 3 dalis, kurių apimtys, dalykas ir reikalavimai apibrėžti specialiųjų pirkimo sąlygų 1-6 prieduose. Tiekėjas gali pateikti pasiūlymą vienai arba visoms pirkimo dalims. Perkančioji organizacija sudarys atskirą sutartį dėl kiekvienos pirkimo dalies.

title: Germany – Track construction works – 2. S-Bahn Stammstrecke München, VE833a Bauabschnitt Oberirdisch Ost und Leuchtenbergring
description: Die gegenständliche Vergabe beinhaltet die Bauleistungen für die die Hauptbaumaßnahmen des Bauabschnitts Oberirdisch Ost (BA60) der 2.SBSS. Der BA60 beinhaltet die Anpassung des Spurplans, die durch die Anbindung der neuen Gleise aus dem Tunnel der 2. S-Bahn-Stammstrecke an die bestehenden S-Bahn-Strecken und aus dem Umbau des Bahnhofsteils Leuchtenbergring auf sechs Bahnsteigkanten verursacht wird. Des Weiteren ist das Rampenbauwerk, mit dem die 2. S-Bahn Stammstrecke aus der Tunnellage an die Oberfläche geführt wird, Teil des Bauabschnitts. Der Umbau des Spurplans erfordert die notwendigen Anpassungen des Bahnkörpers, der Entwässerung, des Kabeltiefbaus, des Oberbaus, der Rettungswege sowie von Brücken- und Stützbauwerken an den geänderten Anforderungen. Die bahntechnische Ausrüstung (Oberleitung, Starkstromanlagen, 50 Hz, und TK) ist an den neuen Spurplan angepasst neu zu errichten. In Zusammenhang wird ein Wendegleis östlich vom Leuchtenbergring ergänzt, um die betrieblichen Anforderungen der neuen 2. S-Bahn-Stammstrecke erfüllen zu können und Anpassungsmaßnahmen an der Wendeanlage MOP W zwischen Ostbahnhof und Leuchtenbergring ausgeführt. Das Rampenbauwerk im BA60 beginnt östlich der Berg-am-Laim-Straße als Tunnel in offener bzw. Deckelbauweise und schließt dort direkt an das Querungsbauwerk der Berg-am-Laim-Straße an. Die Blockfuge stellt die Grenze zwischen den Bauabschnitten BA50 (nicht Teil dieser Ausschreibung) und BA60 (Inhalt dieser Ausschreibung) dar. Es besteht aus dem sogenannten Verteilerbauwerk, in dem die zwei Gleise der 2. Stammstrecke mittels Weichen auf 3 Gleise erweitert werden und den drei sogenannten "Finger-Bauwerken", mit denen die 3 Gleise an die Oberfläche geführt werden. Aufgrund der neuen Gleislage werden Anpassungen am Kreuzungsbauwerks km 1,722 der Strecke 5600 und der Eisenbahnüberführung (EÜ) EÜ Berg-am-Laim Straße km 10,469 Strecke 5510 erforderlich, dabei sind bahnsteigartige Anprallschutzkonstruktionen an den Pfeilern zu erstellen. Zudem sind im Zuge der Umgestaltung des Bahnkörpers 5 Stützwände zu errichten. Für den Umbau der bestehenden Station Leuchtenbergring auf sechs Bahnsteigkanten wird ein neuer Bahnsteig 0 nördlich in freier Lage neben dem bestehenden Gleisfeld errichtet. Der Bahnsteig liegt teilweise über der bestehenden EÜ Leuchtenbergring, aus der Bahnsteigzugänge jeweils vom westlichen und östlichen Gehweg der Leuchtenbergring-Unterführung hergestellt werden. Die EÜ Leuchtenbergring wird durch eine zu errichtende Bahnsteigträgerkonstruktion überspannt. Außerdem werden die Bestandsbahnsteige A und B komplett erneuert, der Bahnsteig A in etwa in Bestandslage, der Bahnsteig B wird nach Osten verlegt. Die vorhandenen Treppenabgänge zur Leuchtenbergring Unterführung werden wie im Bestand beibehalten. In Zusammenhang mit dem Umbau der Bahnsteige wird durch die Landeshauptstadt München ein Fußgängersteg errichtet, der ebenfalls Teil dieser Vergabe ist. Dieser Steg befindet sich westlich der Bahnsteige 0, A und B und überspannt das Gleisfeld von Nord nach Süd. Der Steg wird durch Festtreppen und Aufzüge an die 3 Bahnsteige angeschlossen und gewährleistet einen barrierefreien Zugang zur Verkehrsstation Leuchtenbergring. Die gegenständliche Vergabe beinhaltet die Bauleistungen der genannten Gewerke sowie die Leistungen zur Ausführungsplanung für Baubehelfe. Auszug aus dem Umfang der Leistungen: Verteiler- und Rampenbauwerk ca. 6000 m² Grundfläche in Deckel- und offener Bauweise Gleisbau: ca. 70 Weichen, ca. 9000 m Gleisbau Bahnsteige: ca. 630 m Mittelbahnsteige STEG LHM

description: This is for preventative maintenance and service of Philips Imaging equipment. See the solicitation that follows for full details and requirements. SERVICES TO BE PROVIDED: A. The contractor will arrive on-site for repair within four (4) hours of the original service call. Radiology equipment shall have a guaranteed uptime of 97% or greater. Ultrasound Equipment shall have an uptime of 95% or greater, ensuring minimal downtime for critical diagnostic operations. Documentation and Resources:� The VA shall not provide service manuals or service diagnostic software to the contractor. The contractor shall obtain, have on file, and make available to its FSE(s) all operational and technical documentation (e.g., operational and service manuals, schematics, parts lists) necessary to meet the performance requirements of this contract. The location and listing of the service data manuals, by name, and/or the manuals shall be provided to the CO upon request. Any charges for parts, manuals, tools, or necessary software for maintenance/repairs are included within this contract and its agreed-upon price unless otherwise stated in writing. B. Parts Replacement Parts:� The contractor shall provide all necessary replacement parts to ensure the equipment performs within the manufacturer's specifications. This includes, but is not limited to, coverage for tubes, ultrasound probes, detectors, grids, tables, and batteries. All replacement parts must meet or exceed the factory specifications to maintain compatibility with existing systems and support future performance and reliability upgrades. Any parts removed and replaced by the contractor will become the property of the contractor. Replaced parts must be delivered on-site no later than 10:30 AM the following day. C. Software Updates/Upgrades Software Maintenance:� The contractor will furnish, free of charge, all OEM software or hardware upgrades to the equipment purchased by the VA, which are intended to correct safety risks. Software updates offering enhancements to previously purchased software features shall also be covered under this service agreement if they do not require hardware modifications or additions. D. Scheduled Maintenance Preventive Maintenance (PM):� The contract will include comprehensive scheduled preventive maintenance inspections (PM) as required by manufacturer specifications. Scheduling:� A mutually agreeable time for the inspections will be scheduled through the COR, Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) staff, or the Radiology supervisor/CT Lead. Inspection and Maintenance Procedures:� The contractor will perform PM Services to ensure that equipment listed above functions in conformance with the latest published editions of NFPA-99, OSHA, and CDRH standards. Preventive maintenance procedures will be submitted to the COR for approval prior to initiation of this service and kept on file. PM services shall include, but are not limited to: Cleaning of equipment Reviewing operating system diagnostics to ensure system operation meets manufacturer's specifications Calibrating and lubricating the equipment Performing non-emergent remedial maintenance Testing and replacing faulty or worn parts and/or parts likely to become faulty, fail, or become worn Inspecting and replacing necessary cables and bushings Measuring, adjusting, and calibrating for optimal image quality Inspecting all mechanical components including, but not limited to, probes, cables, mounting hardware, chains, belts, bearings, tracks, interlocks, clutches, motors, monitors, keyboards for mechanical integrity, safety, performance Returning equipment to full and proper operating condition per manufacturer specifications Conducting an electrical safety inspection (as applicable) and documenting the results. title: Roadside Vegetation Brushing 2026 - Highway Operations Unit
description: BIDS RECEIVED BY FAX AND EMAIL WILL BE ACCEPTED AS OFFICIAL. PARKS CANADA IS NOT CURRENTLY ACCEPTING BIDS VIA SAP ARIBA, YOU MUST SUBMIT YOUR BID VIA FAX OR EMAIL AS INDICATED IN THE SOLICITATION DOCUMENT. BIDS RECEIVED IN-PERSON OR BY COURIER WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. The only acceptable email address for responses to bid solicitations is soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca. Bids submitted by email directly to the Contracting Authority or to any email address other than soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca will not be accepted. The only acceptable facsimile for responses to bid solicitations is 1-855-983-1808. The maximum email file size that Parks Canada is capable of receiving is 15 megabytes. The Bidder is responsible for any failure attributable to the transmission or receipt of the emailed bid due to file size. The Bidder should be cognisant of the size of the email as a whole, and not only the attachments. Please take into consideration that some attachments, when sent, may be resized during the email transfer. If the email size is too large, the Bidder should send the bid in multiple emails properly labeled with the solicitation number, project name, and indicate how many emails are included (ex. 1 of 2). Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. Bid documents must be sent as email attachments. REQUIREMENT Parks Canada Agency (PCA) has a requirement for a contractor to provide roadside vegetation management, brushing, clearing, and isolated tree removal services along designated sections of the Trans-Canada Highway in Yoho National Park (approximately 9 km), Highway 93 North in Banff National Park (approximately 19 km), and Highway 93 North in Jasper National Park (approximately 5 km). The work includes the removal and control of grass, brush, shrubs, small trees, and other vegetation within specified highway rights-of-way to improve highway safety by maintain sightlines, protect road infrastructure. and reduce hazards, in accordance with Parks Canada environmental, operational, and traffic management requirements. TWO-SUBMISSION BID This Bid shall be submitted following a “two-submission” procedure. Refer to SI04 of the Special Instructions to Bidders. CONTRACTOR SELECTION AND INDIGENOUS PARTICIPATION PLAN The Contractor should ensure provision of specific and agreed upon benefits for Indigenous People and Indigenous Businesses in the Area of the Contract. This Invitation to Tender contains bid criteria in order to provide socioeconomic benefits to Indigenous communities within the area covered by the contract. PERIOD OF CONTRACT / DELIVERY DATE Contractor shall perform and complete the Work no later than March 31, 2027. OPTIONAL SITE VISIT It is recommended that the Bidder or a representative of the Bidder visit the work site. Arrangements have been made for the site visit to be held at Niblock Pit Gate on HWY 93N (https://maps.app.goo.gl/jYrHNdeHmVudrEqXA) on novembre 24, 2026. The site visit will begin 10:00AM (MDT-HAR). Bidders should communicate with the Contracting Authority no later than novembre 23, 2026, at 11:00AM (MDT-HAR). to confirm attendance and provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend. Bidders must also complete and submit a certification. Bidders who do not confirm attendance, provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend, or who do not complete and submit the above certification as required will not be allowed access to the site. Bidders will be requested to sign an attendance sheet. No alternative appointment will be given to bidders who do not attend or do not send a representative. Bidders who do not participate in the visit will not be precluded from submitting a bid. Any clarifications or changes to the bid solicitation resulting from the site visit will be included as an amendment to the bid solicitation. ENQUIRIES All enquiries of a technical and contractual nature are to be submitted to the Contracting Authority. Enquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing and should be received no later than five (5) business days prior to the date set for solicitation closing to allow sufficient time to provide a response. Enquiries received after that time may result in an answer NOT being provided. INFORMATION National Parks Regulations require that all work is to be performed in accordance with the ordinances, laws, rules and regulations set out in the National Park Act. Bidders that consider themselves qualified to provide this Work and intend to submit bids on this project should obtain documents from the Government Electronic Tendering Service through the Government of Canada tendering service at http://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities. Addenda, when issued, will be available from the Government of Canada tendering service. Bidders that elect to base their bids on documents obtained from other sources do so at their own risk. Late submissions will not be considered. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Parks Canada has made every effort to provide equivalent documents in both official languages, however, if you find any discrepancies between the English and French documents, please notify the contract officer listed in this opportunity as soon as possible so that we can rectify the situation.

title: Tender for contract: Database with general and financial data of corporates and countries on a global scale
description: EIFO wishes to procure access to a global database containing company, financial and credit information to support EIFO's credit assessment and case management activities. The database shall provide coverage of companies on a global scale, including Ukraine and other high-risk countries. The service shall, to the extent available for the individual company and jurisdiction, provide access to: - Company identification and general corporate information; - Ownership information, including shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners and corporate group structures; - Information on management, board members and authorised representatives; - Financial statements, historical financial information and key financial figures; - Credit ratings and other relevant credit information; and - Payment behaviour, negative credit information and other information relevant to the assessment of a company's creditworthiness. The solution shall be accessible through a web-based user interface and shall support report export/download. EIFO expects approximately 50 users and an annual volume of approximately 1000 unique companies. The contract will be concluded for a period of 24 months with an option for EIFO to extend the contract once for a further period of 12 months.

description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL Under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.103-1, and 10 U.S.C. 3201(a) and 40 U.S.C. 113(e)(3), as implemented by FAR Part 41, the Naval Facilities Engineering Command Southeast, Jacksonville, FL, intends to award, on a sole-source basis, a contract for regulated natural-gas distribution service to Delta Utilities Services, LLC. This contract is for the provision of regulated natural-gas distribution service in support of Naval Construction Battalion Center (NCBC) Gulfport, and Naval Air Station Joint Reserve Base New Orleans LA. The Contractor shall furnish, and the Government shall purchase, natural gas and associated distribution services, as requested by authorized Government representatives, in accordance with the terms and conditions of the resulting contract. This notice is not a solicitation and does not constitute a request for competitive proposals. The Government intends to award a sole-source contract to Delta Utilities, the regulated natural-gas distribution utility authorized to provide natural-gas distribution service to the identified Government locations within the applicable service territories in Mississippi and Louisiana. The requirement is limited to the provision of regulated natural-gas distribution service at the identified locations. The Government is not seeking natural-gas marketers, brokers, commodity suppliers, or other firms that cannot demonstrate the legal and regulatory authority to furnish the required natural-gas distribution service within the applicable service territories. Interested Natural Gas distributors may identify their interest and ability to meet the requirements stated herein and may submit their authority to provide service in the form of a tariff or ordinance. Submission must include a valid Cage Code and Employer Identification Number (EIN). FAR 52.214-34 (Submission of Offers in the English Language) apply. The NAICS code associated with this utility procurement is 221210, Natural Gas Distribution. The applicable Small Business Administration size standard is 1,100 employees. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract action based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Contracting Officer. Responses to this posting by an interested party must be submitted to tanisha.v.giddin.civ@us.navy.mil, christopher.c.tucker5.civ@us.navy.mil and ryan.d.bell16.civ@us.navy.mil , in PDF format, no later than 10:00 A.M. EST, 02 December 2026.

NOTE: IF SERVICES ARE REQUIRED AFTER HOURS, THE CONTRACTOR SHALL BE REQUIRED TO PROVIDE A WRITTEN OFFER PRIOR TO ANY SERVICES BEING PERFORMED FOR APPROVAL BY THE COR. NOTE: Hardware/software update/upgrade installations shall be scheduled and performed outside normal hours of coverage at no additional charge to the Government (unless it would be detrimental to equipment up-time; to be determined by the COR). title: Z1DA--NRM CONST - 528A7-18-707 - Replace Boiler Stack Rome CBOC
description: CONTINUATION OF SF 30 BLOCK 14 AMENDMENT DESCRIPTION 0002 AGAINST SOLICITATION NO. 36C24227R0008 1. This amendment answers the following vendor questions: Number of boiler vents: On M-101 (Boiler and Generator Exhaust Plan, Phase II), the new wall penetration/chase is labeled with two 14" I.D. pipes and one 12" I.D. pipe. Keynote 2 calls for a single "new 14" boiler double walled insulated vent stack," and the cutover notes describe that one vent connecting to Boiler #1 and continuing to within two feet of Boiler #2's vent, so one common 14" vent appears to serve both boilers. The solicitation description, however, refers to "two new steel boiler exhaust stacks." Please confirm whether the work is: (a) one 14" double-wall vent common to Boiler #1 and Boiler #2, plus the 12" generator exhaust, or (b) two separate 14" double-wall vents (one per boiler), plus the 12" generator exhaust. If (a), please confirm what the second 14" pipe shown at the penetration represents. Answer: Confirming: it is (b) two separate 14" double-wall vents (one per boiler), plus the 12" generator exhaust. b) Draft control or stack fan: No stack fan, draft inducer, or boiler-outlet draft control appears on the drawings. Section 23 51 00 (paragraph 2.2, Boiler Outlet Dampers and Accessories) refers to automatic draft control specified in Section 23 09 11, but Section 23 09 11 is not included in the solicitation. Please confirm whether: (a) the new boiler vent is intended to operate on natural draft (no fan or draft control required), or (b) a mechanical draft fan and/or barometric or motorized draft control is expected. If so, please issue Section 23 09 11 or identify the required equipment and control sequence. Answer: Confirming: it is (a) the new boiler vent is intended to operate on natural draft (no fan or draft control required). c) Design heating load and operating water temperatures: Please provide the building design heating load (or recent gas and oil usage or meter data), and the normal heating-water supply and return temperatures for the two existing Fulton Vantage boilers. Return-water temperature sets the flue-gas temperature, which governs the vent sizing and draft calculation. Please also confirm whether the two boilers operate as lead/standby (N+1) or are both required at design load. Answer: Replacing the boiler is not part of the contract. Boilers have inducer fans. There is no stack fan or boiler draft controls to be installed. d) Facility designation: Please confirm whether the Rome CBOC is designated mission-critical under VA Physical Security and Resiliency Design requirements, or otherwise required to keep heating on during a utility outage, as this affects the vent design for both fuels. Answer: Rome CBOC is NOT designated as a Critical/Mission Critical facility. CBOCs are generally outpatient facilities rather than hospitals with inpatient, emergency, surgical, or continuity-of-government functions. Therefore, absent a specific VA risk assessment or designation, the Rome CBOC would not ordinarily be assumed to be mission critical. e) Fuel oil and emergency power: Boiler #2 fires #2 fuel oil as a backup fuel. Please confirm (a) whether the vent must be designed for oil firing on Boiler #2 (and on Boiler #1, if applicable), (b) the size and required reserve of the existing #2 oil tank, and (c) whether the boilers and their associated vent or draft equipment are served by emergency power through an automatic transfer switch. Answer: The specified vent material (AL-29-4C) is compatible for operating the boilers on natural gas or #2 oil. This contract does not include altering the existing fuel oil tank, day tank, the boilers, or the generator. We are eliminating the existing exhaust stack and installing a new exhaust stack in a different location to serve the two existing boilers and existing emergency generator. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged.

description: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. This is an RFI released pursuant to Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 5 (Presolicitation & Early Industry Exchanges) & Part 12 (Commercial Streamlining). This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes; it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) nor a promise to issue an RFP or other solicitation. This RFI does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is not currently seeking proposals. All costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the expense of the respondent. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future solicitation. Vendors should not interpret the listed requirements as final or representative of CBP's actual requirements. The listed requirements are for informational purposes only and are covered in attachment #1. This purpose of this RFI is to gather market research information for acquisition planning purposes in anticipation of issuing a Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) to provide canines to the Field Office K9 (FOK9) and Border Patrol K9 (BPK9) training centers. Relevant to this RFI, please include the following suggested information. Company Information Legal business name, address, website, and primary point of contact. Use a clear, professional format with readable headings and standard fonts. Limit comments to about the attached SOW. This is not an RFP, do not include any pricing information. Responses on this RFI must be sent via email to the following: CBP Procurement POC: Danielle Brandao Lacerda, Contract Specialist at DANIELLE.BRANDAOLACERDA@cbp.dhs.gov and John Crockett, Contracting Officer, at JOHN.T.CROCKETT@cbp.dhs.gov RFI responses must be electronically submitted to the procurement POC by 12:00 pm EDT on December 2nd, 2026. description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE This is a Sources Sought Notice ONLY. The U.S. Government desires to procure Wi-Fi internet network services for 5th Brigade (BDE) San Antonio Drill Competition on a small business set-aside basis, provided 2 or more qualified small businesses respond to this sources sought notice with information sufficient to support a set-aside. Be advised that the U.S. Government will not be able to set aside this requirement if 2 or more small businesses do not respond with information to support the set-aside. We encourage all small businesses, in all socioeconomic categories (including, 8(a) Business Development Program, Small Disadvantage Business, Historically Underutilized Business Zone, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned, Women-Owned Small Business concerns), to identify their capabilities in meeting the requirement at a fair market price. This notice is issued solely for information and planning purposes � it does not constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ)/Invitation for Bid (IFB)/Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFQ, IFB or RFP in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service. Further, the U.S. Government is not seeking quotes, bids or proposals at this time and will not accept unsolicited proposals in response to this sources sought notice. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. Submittals will not be returned to the responder. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future RFQ or IFB or RFP, if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the Government-wide Point of Entry. It is the responsibility of potential offerors to monitor the Government-wide Point of Entry for additional information pertaining to this requirement. The anticipated NAICS code(s) is/are: 517112 � Wireless Telecommunications Carriers (except Satellite) � Size Standard of 1,500 employees. Attached is the draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) for details. Responses to this Sources Sought Notice shall be e-mailed to the Contract Specialist, Jazlyne T. Barnes, at jazlyne.t.barnes.civ@army.mil AND the KO, Anthony H. Johnson, at anthony.h.johnson.civ@army.mil no later than 02 December 2026 at 11:00 a.m. ET (Fort Knox local time). It does apply to 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, EDWOSB, and WOSB set-asides regardless of the dollar value of the award. Small business contractors awarded contracts above the SAT are required to comply with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 52.219-14, Limitations on Subcontracting when utilizing subcontractors. description: Request for Information 36C10B27Q0010 Page 2 of 2 Request for Information 36C10B27Q0010 Enterprise Database Vulnerability Scanning Solution INTRODUCTION This is a Request for Information (RFI) notice for planning purposes only and shall not be considered an Invitation for Bid, Request for Task Execution Plan, Request for Quotation, or a Request for Proposal. Additionally, there is no obligation on the part of the Government to acquire any products described in this notice. Your response to this RFI notice will be treated only as information for the Government to consider. You will not be entitled to payment for direct or indirect costs that you incur in responding to this RFI notice. Any Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) or Veteran-owned small businesses (VOSBs) responding to this RFI notice must include their intent and ability to meet set-aside requirements for performance of this effort in accordance with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) 852.219-73 or 852.219-74, VA Notice of Total Set-Aside for SDVOSB or VOSB respectively. Specifically, the requirement for at least 50% of the cost of manufacturing or 50% of the services be performed by yourself and/or other eligible and Small Business Administration verified SDVOSB/VOSB concerns; and certification from the Small Business Administration (VetCert). It is requested that all companies interested in participating in this RFI please note their interest and provide indication of their respective capabilities to perform the potential effort, as described in the paragraphs below and the Draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) Description. Any information submitted by respondents to this RFI notice is strictly voluntary. All submissions become Government property and will not be returned. VA reserves the right to not respond to any, all, or select responses or materials submitted. All requirements identified herein are subject to change at any time. The purpose of this RFI notice is for planning purposes, to identify market information and qualified contractors who are able to meet VA s requirement for Enterprise Database Vulnerability Scanning Solution. Any information provided in response to this RFI notice may be used by VA in developing its acquisition strategy and Performance Work Statement, as well as determining any set-aside decisions. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this requirement is 541519, Other Computer Related Services, with a size standard of 34 Million. Be advised that set-aside decisions may be made based on the information provided in response to this RFI notice. Responses shall be as complete and informative as possible. It is the responsibility of interested parties to monitor this site for updates and/or additional information pertaining to this requirement. BACKGROUND: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Office of Information and Technology, Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC), requires an enterprise database vulnerability scanning solution to support recurring security assessments and Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities. VA currently uses LevelBlue Trustwave DbProtect across four production environments and one development environment. The existing capability includes centralized management, distributed scanning, vulnerability assessment content, reporting and analytics, and supporting repository and data-processing functions. Scanning components operate on premises and within VA Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure environments. Management, reporting, and repository functions are hosted on premises. The current repository retains 12 months of scan information and uses approximately 3.17 terabytes (TB) of storage. VA conducts monthly enterprise scanning and daily on-demand scans supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities. title: R614--Tennessee Valley Healthcare Services Document Destruction Shredding Services Base plus 4 year contract
description: Department of Veterans Affairs Solicitation No.: 36C24927Q0014 Amendment No.: 0004 Date: November 23, 2026 1. Purpose of Amendment This amendment provides clarification regarding: Use of an SBA-certified SDVOSB subcontractor for specialized shredding and document-destruction services; Licensing and insurance requirements applicable to the prime contractor and subcontractors; Limitations on subcontracting performance requirements; and Required container quantities and sizes at each performance location. Except as specifically amended or clarified herein, all other terms and conditions of the solicitation remain unchanged. 2. Use of an SBA-Certified SDVOSB Subcontractor Question May an SBA-certified SDVOSB prime contractor subcontract the physical shredding and document-destruction services to another SBA-certified SDVOSB, provided the arrangement complies with VAAR 852.219-75, 13 CFR 125.6, and the prime contractor retains responsibility for contract performance? Government Response Generally, yes. An SBA-certified SDVOSB prime contractor may subcontract work to another properly certified SDVOSB, including substantial physical shredding and document-destruction work, provided the arrangement complies with all applicable requirements, including VAAR 852.219-75 and 13 CFR 125.6. The prime contractor shall: Verify that the proposed subcontractor is properly certified as an SDVOSB and qualifies as a similarly situated entity when applicable; Ensure that the subcontractor performs the work directly and does not further subcontract the work in a manner inconsistent with applicable law or regulation; Comply with the applicable limitations on subcontracting; Retain overall responsibility for contract performance, quality control, contract administration, customer communication, security compliance, and required reporting; Fully disclose the proposed subcontracting arrangement in its quotation; and Ensure that the subcontracting arrangement is consistent with the technical quotation, price quotation, staffing plan, equipment plan, licensing documentation, and insurance documentation. Payments to a qualifying similarly situated entity may be treated in accordance with applicable SBA regulations and VAAR requirements when calculating compliance with the limitations on subcontracting. The prime contractor remains responsible for maintaining adequate records demonstrating compliance. The separately completed and signed VAAR 852.219-75(d) certification is required. The subcontracting approach does not replace the required certification. 3. Licensing and Insurance Requirements Question The solicitation requires licensing and insurance documentation in the prime contractor s name. Please clarify the specific licenses and insurance coverages that the prime contractor must independently maintain when specialized shredding services are performed by a qualified subcontractor. Government Response The prime contractor shall independently maintain and provide all licenses, registrations, permits, and insurance required by the solicitation, the resulting contract, and applicable federal, state, county, and municipal law for the work for which the prime contractor is responsible. The prime contractor shall not rely solely on a subcontractor s licenses or insurance to satisfy a requirement expressly imposed on the prime contractor. As applicable, the prime contractor shall maintain and provide documentation for: Current business and contractor registrations required in the jurisdictions where services are performed; Any licenses, registrations, permits, or authorizations required by applicable federal, state, or local law for the services the contractor elects to perform; Any waste, recycling, transportation, disposal, or related permits applicable to the prime contractor s responsibilities; Commercial general liability insurance; Automobile liability insurance for vehicles used in contract performance; Workers compensation and employer s liability coverage as required by law; and Any additional insurance expressly required by the solicitation or resulting contract. The exact coverage limits, endorsements, certificate wording, effective dates, and additional-insured requirements shall be governed by the solicitation and resulting contract. The prime contractor shall submit certificates of insurance in the prime contractor s legal name and shall identify the Department of Veterans Affairs or the United States Government as an additional insured when required by the contract. A subcontractor performing specialized shredding or document-destruction services shall independently maintain all licenses, permits, registrations, and insurance legally required for the work it performs. The prime contractor shall obtain and retain current copies of the subcontractor s documentation and shall verify that the documentation remains current throughout contract performance. Subcontractor licenses and insurance do not relieve the prime contractor of its contractual responsibilities or of any insurance requirement imposed directly on the prime contractor. 4. Container Quantity Clarification The required container quantities and sizes are as follows: Location 35 Gallon 64 Gallon 95 Gallon Total Alvin C. York VAMC 140 2 4 146 Nashville Campus 149 4 1 154 Quoters shall use the quantities identified in this amendment when preparing pricing, staffing, equipment, transportation, servicing, and document-destruction calculations.
